title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination 2025
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘including the European pillar of social rights’
part_context: Welcomes the Commission’s recommendations regarding the economic policy of the euro area, urging the Member States to enhance competitiveness and foster productivity through improved access to funding for businesses, reduced administrative burdens, and public and private investment in areas of EU common priorities, which include (i) a fair green and digital transition, (ii) social and economic resilience <del>including the European pillar of social rights</del>, (iii) energy security, and (iv) the build-up of defence capabilities;
